cold
In two and a half minutes, these tablets get wiped.
It happens before every survey round. And one question decides whether a week of fieldwork survives it.
Is anything on here still the only copy?
problem
The server says received. But received isn't complete.
A photo can fail to upload. A whole record can get stuck on the device.
And a spreadsheet can look short, when nothing is missing at all.
brand
LastCopy answers that question, tablet by tablet, before the reset.
zetaris
It starts with Zetaris.
The tablet exports, the server, the spreadsheet and the file objects stay exactly where they are. One SQL layer queries all of them.
Seven queries. Twelve seconds. This is the one that found the missing photo.
agents
Then the agents take over.
A Meterless World Model holds the investigation as a graph, and picks every next step.
NVIDIA Nemotron proposes hypotheses. The Reviewer rejected three of them, before a single file was fetched.
bytes
But no model gets to decide.
Code opens the original archives and checks seven things, byte for byte.
adversary
Before anything is cleared, an Adversary tries to break it.
Five objections. Each one answered from the raw bytes, or the tablet stays put.
decide
Tablet one: safe to wipe.
Tablet two: recover the photo first. Tablet three: a record never arrived.
Four and five: hold, for a person.
proof
Every answer ships with a certificate. Anyone can re-check it, with no model, and without LastCopy.
blind
And it doesn't just pass its own demo.
Five hundred blind fleets, with problems hidden from the agents. Every tablet decided correctly. None wrongly cleared.
close
Wipe tablet one. Keep the rest.
LastCopy. Know before you wipe.
